teach_en: Lao vowels can sit before, above, below or after the consonant, and some come in several parts around it. However a vowel is written, you say the consonant first and the vowel second. The next vowel, ເ◌ົາ, starts on the page before its consonant: read past it to the consonant, then say the vowel.
notes: Lead-in card before V35 ເ◌ົາ, the first vowel written before its consonant (owner 2026-11-13: teach the principle first, the vowel card keeps a short reminder). Standard Lao spelling fact (preposed vowels are pronounced after the initial consonant). No respellings (LESSON_RULES 13). Wording by agent.
